notes.title: We opened a pop-up store in Japan at Ikebukuro PARCO!!
notes.content:
Long time no see! We’ve shared various news before—like the reservation sale for the Nintendo Switch package edition and upcoming concerts—but now we have some more exciting news!

Surprise: The “Meg and Bakemono” pop-up store has opened at Ikebukuro PARCO!
Come and check out the store’s decor, which is inspired by a festival from the underworld, along with brand-new merchandise specially made for this event.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42421433/dc9aa9323d17eec3ebf4283d8a7277006f769835.png[/img]

Location: Japan, Ikebukuro PARCO, 4th Floor Event Space
Dates: February 7, 2025 (Fri) – February 24, 2025 (Mon)
Hours: 11:00 – 21:00 (Note: On the final day, the store closes at 18:00)
On February 22, there will be a signing event with artist Thomas (limited to purchases of 6000 yen or more).

For more details, visit:
https://art.parco.jp/ikebukuro/detail/?id=1654

You can also make reservations online during the event period:
https://online.parco.jp/shop/e/e10000112/

If you’re looking to ship items internationally from Japan, consider using this service:
https://online.parco.jp/shop/pages/about_buyeeconnect.aspx?_ga=

Here are some photos of the store and the merchandise:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42421433/9a46dd2a76059d02a6589f3705f6f21a4a1ed02a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42421433/27f1f769d6f8ccb9b3dd34c1b0a3b7c6bf227415.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42421433/89613284bb8d38c82cc883d2b4e5020ceceaca6d.png[/img]

If you’re able to make it, please come by! Have a good day.

notes.title: Fixes for Freezing Issue and Addition of Russian and Indonesian
notes.content: We fixed an issue where the game could freeze during gameplay when using the latest version of the Steam SDK. Additionally, Russian and Indonesian languages have been added. Other minor bug fixes and performance improvements were also implemented.

notes.title: Let's nominate Meg's Monster for "Outstanding Story-Rich Game" Category!
notes.content: Meg's Monster' is a game characterized by the contrasting relationship between a girl named Meg and a monster named Roy. This unique concept is consistently reflected not only in the storyline but also in character design, artwork, and music. Enjoy a narrative experience unique to gaming. We appreciate your support for the nomination!

notes.title: Meg's Monster Included in Tiny Teams 2023!
notes.content:
We've got some amazing news to share with everyone today!

*Drum roll...*

[b]Meg's Monster has been selected for Tiny Teams 2023![/b]

We're over the moon at the honor of being selected for such a prestigious festival, and the Yogscast team is a very cool bunch! You'll see Meg's Monster and some other games from August 3 to 10, and keep an eye out for some cool surprises during the week. We've also got Meg's Monster on sale now until the end of Tiny Teams Fest, so if you haven't purchased the game yet, now's a great time!

If you'd like to check out more of which games are in Tiny Teams 2023, please head over to the official Steam page: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/tinyteamsfestival2023 ]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/tinyteamsfestival2023 [/url]

notes.title: Adjustment of lines, minor bug fixes, and Direct11 support.
notes.content:
I thought there were no bugs or issues, but of course, that was not the case...
We have made adjustments to some lines and fixed minor bugs.
Also, we have added support for Direct11, which may reduce issues with capturing in OBS. If you encounter any problems while playing or streaming, please let us know.

notes.title: Thank you for a Monster-sized launch!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42421433/f78ca678cbb291346e1814931854d85789457bdf.png[/img]

It's been a wonderful few days since we released Meg's Monster, and we've received a ton of support from our fans! From a very positive rating with over 150 reviews on Steam to a Strong rating on Opencritic, we've been getting some great critical reception as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42421433/1efad4b969655c06a2afbe9c6fc01fd9e7d6bf80.png[/img]

Thank you to all those who have already played the game and those who will play it in the future. We hope the story and characters will remain in everyone's memories long after the credits roll! 

For those who haven't played the game yet, our launch discount will still be available for a few more days. And as a thank you to all our amazing fans so far, composer Reo Uratani made a wonderful video highlighting the soundtrack he made for the game! Check it out!

[previewyoutube=9GYmKbzQFsA;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Special Demo Now Available on Steam!
notes.content:
A free demo of Meg's Monster is available now! Featuring approximately forty minutes of gameplay (including some unique scenes that will play out differently in the full game), we encourage all players to give it a try and check out Odencat’s first-ever turn-based battle system for themselves, while also getting a taste of the game’s rich, atmospheric world and soundtrack. We have also announced plans to stream the demo with developer commentary as part of SteamNextFest (beginning on October 3rd)

notes.title: Meg's Monster has you help a lost girl get home before she causes the apocalypse
notes.content:
Well, this is quite a story. Meg's Monster is the next and biggest game so far from developer Odencat, where you need to help a lost little girl get home. The problem is, she has some awesome power and might just cause some kind of monster apocalypse.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2022/05/megs-monster-has-you-help-a-lost-girl-get-home-before-she-causes-the-apocalypse
